overview: Docket (1940-44) indexes Japanese press clippings: wartime Roosevelt cartoons, Japanese Embassy surveillance, Justice Department press monitoring, Turkey propaganda, and extensive Buenos Aires Japanese-press translations.

subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers for file 894.9111
subfiles.about: This two-page index describes papers concerning Japanese newspapers, press translations, cartoons, clippings, and propaganda filed as items 4–21 under decimal file 894.9111.
subfiles.summary: Docket (1940-44) indexes Japanese press clippings: political cartoons, Embassy attaché surveillance, Justice Department press summaries, and extensive Buenos Aires Japanese-newspaper translations.

interest: Shows wartime US monitoring of Japanese-language media worldwide, from Tokyo cartoons to Buenos Aires press translations.
